title: A sheaf of abelian groups on a basis extends to a sheaf on the space
statement: Let $X$ be a topological space and $\mathcal B$ a set of open subsets of $X$ which is a basis of the topology and satisfies $U\cap V\in\mathcal B$ for all $U,V\in\mathcal B$. Let $F$ be a presheaf of abelian groups on $\mathcal B$: abelian groups $F(U)$ for $U\in\mathcal B$ and group homomorphisms $r_{U,V}:F(U)\to F(V)$ for $V\subseteq U$ in $\mathcal B$ with $r_{U,U}=\mathrm{id}$ and $r_{V,W}r_{U,V}=r_{U,W}$. Suppose that for every $U\in\mathcal B$ and every family $(U_i)_{i\in I}$ of members of $\mathcal B$ with $\bigcup_iU_i=U$ ($I$ arbitrary, possibly empty) and every family $s_i\in F(U_i)$ with $r_{U_i,U_i\cap U_j}(s_i)=r_{U_j,U_i\cap U_j}(s_j)$ for all $i,j$, there is exactly one $s\in F(U)$ with $r_{U,U_i}(s)=s_i$ for all $i$. Then there is a sheaf of abelian groups $F^{ext}$ on $X$ together with group isomorphisms $\iota_U:F^{ext}(U)\to F(U)$ for $U\in\mathcal B$ such that $\iota_V(t|_V)=r_{U,V}(\iota_U(t))$ for $V\subseteq U$ in $\mathcal B$ and $t\in F^{ext}(U)$.

source.place: Sheaves on Spaces, Section 009H: Lemma 009M (label lemma-condition-star-sections), Lemma 009N (label lemma-extend-off-basis) with its proof (F^ext(W) = families of germs (s_x) in the stalks F_x = colim_{x in U in B} F(U) satisfying (*); sheaf by the argument of Lemma 007Y, label lemma-sheafification-sheaf), Lemma 009Q (label lemma-extend-off-basis-structures) for the abelian group structure; Definition 009J and Lemma 009L for the form of the sheaf condition when B is closed under intersections

proof.text: Let G : B → Opens(X) be the fully faithful inclusion. Its object range is B, so TopCat.Opens.coverDense_iff_isBasis makes G cover dense for the topology K of open coverings. Put J = G.inducedTopology K. We prove F is a J-sheaf by applying CategoryTheory.Presheaf.isSheaf_of_isSheaf_comp to the forgetful functor from abelian groups to sets; this functor reflects the required limits (Mathlib.Algebra.Category.Grp.Limits). The underlying set-valued sheaf condition is CategoryTheory.isSheaf_iff_isSheaf_of_type.

Fix U in B, a J-covering sieve S on U, and a compatible family s on S. By Functor.mem_inducedTopology_iff_of_isCoverDense, the sieve S.functorPushforward G covers U in X. Index by the ULift to Type(max u v w) of all pairs (V, f : V → U) with f in S, and use the basic opens V with their inclusions into U. They cover U: for x in U the pushforward covering provides W containing x, an arrow g : Z → U in S, and an inclusion k : W → Z; hence x belongs to the indexed basic open Z. Every indexed open is contained in U, so their supremum is exactly U. Set ss(V,f) = s(f). Compatibility of s applied to the two inclusions of V ∩ V′ implies the intersection compatibility required by hglue, since this category is thin. Apply hglue to obtain a unique t in F(U). Each arrow f in S is one of the indices, so t amalgamates s. Conversely, any amalgamation of s restricts to every indexed ss(V,f), so uniqueness in hglue proves uniqueness of the amalgamation. This proves the underlying set-valued sheaf condition, including empty covers, and thus the group-valued sheaf condition.

Apply the comparison equivalence E = G.sheafInducedTopologyEquivOfIsCoverDense K AddCommGrpCat to the sheaf FB = (F,hF). Abelian groups have all limits of the required shapes, so FE = E.functor.obj FB is the required sheaf on X. This is an explicit application of the comparison construction, not a witness chosen from an unproved existence theorem. The inverse of E is restriction along G. Therefore e = E.unitIso.symm.app FB is an isomorphism from the restriction of FE to FB. Apply sheafToPresheaf and evaluate e at each op U to obtain iota_U : FE(U) ≅ F(U). Naturality of e.hom at the opposite of V → U, evaluated at t, is exactly iota_V(t|V) = F(V → U)(iota_U(t)).

split_report.summary: Decided not a Mathlib leaf. The comparison-lemma route was read in the source: Functor.sheafInducedTopologyEquivOfIsCoverDense (InducedTopology.lean:159) is IsDenseSubsite.sheafEquiv = (sheafPushforwardContinuous ..).asEquivalence.symm (DenseSubsite/Basic.lean:797), so with G = inducedFunctor of B (cover dense by TopCat.Opens.coverDense_inducedFunctor, Sites.lean:135) and A = AddCommGrpCat its functor gives F^ext and the component at U of the isomorphism inverse.obj (functor.obj F) ≅ F (inverse = restriction along G) gives iota_U, naturality giving compatibility: one declaration per clause there. But the hypothesis is not yet Presheaf.IsSheaf (G.inducedTopology _) F: it needs isSheaf_iff_isSheaf_forget (Sheaf.lean:730), isSheaf_iff_isSheaf_of_type, mem_inducedTopology_iff_of_isCoverDense with Opens.mem_grothendieckTopology (a sieve S on U in B covers iff its members cover U), and then an argument that a compatible family for S is a family agreeing on pairwise intersections (V ∩ V' in B and in S) and conversely, for which there is no single declaration (isSheafFor_arrows_iff_pullbacks needs HasPairwisePullbacks in the category of members of B, which no instance gives; Precoverage.toGrothendieck_comap_eq_restrictedTopology needs a precoverage presentation of the topology of X). So, as instructed, the item is split along Stacks 009N/009Q: (1) stalks on B (new def-weil-pbc-basis-presheaf-stalk, Mathlib leaf: a colimit in AddCommGrpCat) and Lemma 009M (new lem-weil-pbc-basis-sheaf-sections-germs, unsplit); (2) F^ext(W) = families of germs satisfying (*), a local predicate, hence a sheaf by Stacks 007Y = TopCat.subpresheafToTypes.isSheaf (new lem-weil-pbc-local-predicate-sections-sheaf, Mathlib leaf); (3) F^ext(W) is a subgroup of the product of stalks (Stacks 009Q, details written out); (4) iota_U = inverse of s ↦ (s_x), bijective by 009M, compatible with restrictions. The comparison-lemma route stays recorded in mathlib_searches as a generalization candidate. Statement unchanged; lean_audit none on both branches; the source repository has no extension-from-basis declaration (inducedTopology occurs only in hasSheafify_inducedTopology_equivSmallModel and the small-model sheafification instances, all sorry-free and unrelated).

lean.statement: theorem exists_sheaf_extension_of_basis_gluing (X : TopCat.{u}) (B : Set (Opens X)) (hB : IsBasis B) (hcap : ∀ U V : B, U.val ⊓ V.val ∈ B) (F : Bᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{max u v}) (hglue : ∀ (U : B) (I : Type (max u v w)) (V : I → {W : B // W ≤ U}), (⨆ i, (V i).val.val) = U.val → ∀ s : ∀ i, F.obj (op (V i).val), (∀ i j, (F.map (homOfLE (show (⟨(V i).val.val ⊓ (V j).val.val, hcap (V i).val (V j).val⟩ : B) ≤ (V i).val from inf_le_left (a := (V i).val.val) (b := (V j).val.val))).op).hom (s i) = (F.map (homOfLE (show (⟨(V i).val.val ⊓ (V j).val.val, hcap (V i).val (V j).val⟩ : B) ≤ (V j).val from inf_le_right (a := (V i).val.val) (b := (V j).val.val))).op).hom (s j)) → ∃! t : F.obj (op U), ∀ i, (F.map (homOfLE (V i).property).op).hom t = s i) : ∃ Fext : TopCat.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{max u v} X, ∃ iota : ∀ U : B, Fext.presheaf.obj (op U.val) ≅ F.obj (op U), ∀ (U V : B) (hVU : V ≤ U) (t : Fext.presheaf.obj (op U.val)), (iota V).hom.hom ((Fext.presheaf.map (homOfLE (show V.val ≤ U.val from hVU)).op).hom t) = (F.map (homOfLE hVU).op).hom ((iota U).hom.hom t)
